svg.title: 2 in 3 pull requests the review agent sent back came back fixed and were approved; 24 minutes typical from sent back to approved
svg.text: The review agent sent 563 pull requests
back. Two in three came back fixed,
563 sent back (oct '26); 140 merged as-is after a second review.
